events.text: This refund-support browser UI, backend route, RAG query, and grounding guard are authored in .kern and run through the native runner preview.

<script type="module">const q=document.getElementById('question');const a=document.getElementById('answer');const s=document.getElementById('status');const nl=String.fromCharCode(10);document.getElementById('ask').addEventListener('click',async()=>{s.textContent='Running native runner preview';a.textContent='';try{const r=await fetch('/api/answer?question='+encodeURIComponent(q.value));const data=await r.json();if(!r.ok){s.textContent='Failed';a.textContent=data.error||'Request failed';return;}s.textContent='Grounding: '+data.status;a.textContent=data.answer+nl+nl+'source: '+data.source+nl+'chunks: '+data.chunkCount;}catch{s.textContent='Failed';a.textContent='Request failed';}});</script>
